residualRisk.summary: Round-1 findings (unsorted planFiles, non-reproducible validation command, .env.example ownership, cold-import guard) were all closed in r3 and re-verified by the focused round 2; no open findings remain.

summary: Independent two-round read-only audit of the refrozen stage 8 package. Round 1 (r2) returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with two MEDIUM findings (planFiles not lexicographically sorted — the exact stage 7 lock-create blocker; validation.commands[1] written in a form that cannot execute from the repository root) and two LOW findings (.env.example outside the write-set despite five new operator variables; an unguarded circular ImportError on a hypothetical cold import of app.api.v1.router). Round 1 also confirmed the architecture as a whole: composition seam, authorization reuse, file-contract consumption, honest pgvector/JSON-vector environment claims and the UNAVAILABLE policy for the absent Ollama. Round 2 (r3, focused) verified all four fixes landed exactly as declared — sorted planFiles, the stage 5-6 precedent command form, .env.example in writes with consistent documentation across manifest/overview/plan.md, and the explicit cold-import guard contract — and re-ran the structural gates itself. Verdict: READY_TO_FREEZE.
